{{Quote|Many of my clients are reluctant to let friends and family know of their interest in the dark side.|Argel Tenn|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
'''Argel Tenn''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] antique dealer who dealt in the trade of illegal [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Dynasty" />

Tenn often dealt with [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], whom he believed to be a simple collector known as Sepp Omek. When Bane requested any object having to do with [[Darth Andeddu]], Tenn brought an aged scroll made of cured animal skin to Bane. The scroll was a religious proclamation that declared Darth Andeddu the Immortal and Eternal king of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. Using the knowledge supplied by Argel Tenn Darth Bane was able to [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|locate]] the [[Andeddu's Keep|tomb of Darth Andeddu]], find [[Holocron of Heresies|Andeddu's holocron]], and learn the secrets of [[essence transfer]].<ref name="Dynasty" />

Bane's apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] later approached Tenn to ask him about his dealings with Bane. Initially he had refused to tell her anything, claiming that discretion was the cornerstone of his business. It was not until after she revealed herself to be a Sith that he told her about Darth Andeddu. Fearing that he may spread the knowledge that the Sith still survived, she was left with no choice but to kill him.<ref name="Dynasty" />

==Personality and traits==
Tenn was a trader of ancient Sith artifacts in the time following the New Sith Wars when such exotic items where made illegal throughout the galaxy. He portrayed himself as an expert on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and frequently did business with collectors and Sith fetishists. He was known for being discreet keeping his customers names from ever being linked to the transaction.<ref name="Dynasty" />
